local RS=game:GetService('ReplicatedStorage') local ok,err=pcall(function() local PS=require(RS.Shared.PortScene) PS.build({portId='amsterdam',portName='amsterdam',level=4,shipId='galleon',hasShipyard=true,facilities={'bank','guild','harbormaster'},storyCount=0,companions={}},function() end) end) local c=game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character if c and c:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart') then c.HumanoidRootPart.Anchored=true c:PivotTo(CFrame.new(-6,6,10)) end return 'built '..tostring(ok)..' local f=workspace:FindFirstChild('PortScene') local list={} for _,m in f:GetDescendants() do if m:IsA('Model') and m.Name=='Villager' and m:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid') then local p=m:GetPivot().Position if math.abs(p.Y)<4 then table.insert(list,m) end end end table.sort(list,function(a,b) return a:GetPivot().Position.X<b:GetPivot().Position.X end) local k=1 local step=math.max(1,math.floor(#list/6)) _G.VTarget=list[math.min(#list,1+(k-1)*step)] local t=_G.VTarget if t then local q=t:GetPivot().Position workspace:SetAttribute('ShotCF',CFrame.lookAt(q+Vector3.new(2.5,9,5),q+Vector3.new(0,2.2,0))) end return 'villagers='..#list..' pick='..tostring(_G.VTarget and _G.VTarget:GetPivot().Position)
